verses.verse:
षड्जधैवतमानेन ऋषभात्तीव्र मध्यमः।
तयोर्मध्ये च गान्धारः शुद्धस्थाप्यो मनीषिभिः।।२९।।
verses.text: By the measure from Ṣaḍja to Dhaivata, tīvra Madhyama [is placed] from Ṛṣabha; and between the two the wise should place śuddha Gāndhāra.

commentary.text: Measure the distance from Sa down to Dhaivata, and place tīvra (sharp) Madhyama that same height above Ṛṣabha, and śuddha Gāndhāra in the middle between Sa and tīvra Ma′.
